title.en: Collaboration, Interpersonal Communication, and Business Etiquette
title.ms: Kolaborasi, Komunikasi Interpersonal dan Etiket Perniagaan

en: List the advantages and disadvantages of teams, characteristics of effective teams, and four key issues of group dynamics
Offer guidelines for collaborative communication, identify collaboration technologies, and give constructive feedback
List the key steps for productive team meetings
Identify the major technologies that enhance or replace in-person meetings
Identify modes of listening, describe the listening process, and explain selective listening
Explain the importance of nonverbal communication and identify six categories of nonverbal expression
Explain the importance of business etiquette and identify key areas where it is essential
ms: Senaraikan kelebihan dan kekurangan pasukan, ciri pasukan berkesan, dan empat isu dinamik kumpulan
Beri garis panduan komunikasi kolaboratif, kenal pasti teknologi kolaborasi, dan beri maklum balas membina
Senaraikan langkah utama mesyuarat pasukan yang produktif
Kenal pasti teknologi utama yang menambah atau menggantikan mesyuarat bersemuka
Kenal pasti mod mendengar, huraikan proses mendengar, dan terangkan pendengaran terpilih
Terangkan kepentingan komunikasi bukan lisan dan kenal pasti enam kategori ekspresi bukan lisan
Terangkan kepentingan etiket perniagaan dan kenal pasti bidang utama yang memerlukannya

blocks.en: A **team** is a unit of **two or more people** who share a **mission** and the **responsibility** for working to achieve a **common goal**.
blocks.ms: **Pasukan** ialah unit **dua orang atau lebih** yang berkongsi **misi** dan **tanggungjawab** untuk mencapai **matlamat bersama**.

en: Assembles to resolve specific issues; cross-functional for maximum diversity; disbands once goal is achieved
ms: Berhimpun menyelesaikan isu khusus; merentas fungsi untuk kepelbagaian maksimum; bubar bila matlamat dicapai

en: Assembles to resolve specific issues; cross-functional; disbands once goal is achieved
ms: Berhimpun menyelesaikan isu khusus; merentas fungsi; bubar bila matlamat dicapai

en: Assembles regularly for ongoing and recurring issues; focused teams (e.g. strategic planning); formal teams with long life span
ms: Berhimpun secara tetap untuk isu berterusan dan berulang; pasukan fokus (cth perancangan strategik); pasukan formal berjangka hayat panjang

blocks.en: The slide text groups the three columns in a table; I mapped the lines to each team type by reading order. Check slide 5 if unsure.
blocks.ms: Teks slaid mengumpulkan tiga lajur dalam jadual; saya padankan baris kepada setiap jenis mengikut susunan bacaan. Semak slaid 5 jika ragu.

blocks.en: Task force and problem-solving team end when the goal is done. A committee is long-lived.
blocks.ms: Task force dan pasukan penyelesaian masalah tamat bila matlamat siap. Jawatankuasa berpanjangan.

en: Initiating (starts inquiry); Information giving or seeking; Coordinating (shows relationships, summarises); Procedure setting (suggests decision procedures)
ms: Initiating (mulakan siasatan); Memberi/mencari maklumat; Coordinating (tunjuk hubungan, ringkaskan); Procedure setting (cadang prosedur keputusan)

en: Encouraging (support, praise); Harmonizing (mediate, humour); Compromising (yield on a point)
Controlling (dominating); Withdrawing (silent or refuses); Attention seeking; Diverting (topics of personal interest)
ms: Controlling (mendominasi); Withdrawing (diam/enggan); Attention seeking (mahu perhatian); Diverting (topik minat sendiri)

blocks.en: Slide 11 (Allowing for Team Evolution) is an image/figure with no text. The textbook shows the stages of team development.
blocks.ms: Slaid 11 (Allowing for Team Evolution) ialah imej tanpa teks. Buku teks menunjukkan peringkat pembangunan pasukan.

en: Give the team time to bond
Ensure tools are ready and compatible
Think through your suggested changes carefully
Highlight any limitations your feedback may have
ms: Fokus pada tingkah laku yang boleh dikawal
Pilih masa maklum balas dengan teliti

blocks.en: Say “here is how to make it clearer”, not “this is confusing”. Comment on the message, not the person.
blocks.ms: Cakap “beginilah cara menjadikannya lebih jelas”, bukan “ini mengelirukan”. Komen mesej, bukan orang.

ms: Guna peranti mudah alih dengan hormat

en: Include: instant messaging, teleconferencing, telepresence, webinars
ms: Termasuk: pesanan segera, telesidang, telepresence, webinar

en: Be aware of limitations of technology

blocks.ms: Slaid 24 dan 25 (Agenda Mesyuarat; Merekod Keputusan) ialah rajah tanpa teks.

blocks.en: The learning objective says three major modes; the slide lists four terms. Your textbook treats content, critical and empathic as the three modes and active listening as a technique. Confirm with your lecturer.
blocks.ms: Objektif kata tiga mod utama; slaid menyenaraikan empat istilah. Buku teks menganggap content, critical dan empathic sebagai tiga mod dan active listening sebagai teknik. Sahkan dengan pensyarah.

ms: Tiada nota atau nota tidak berkesan
Kurang atau tidak sesuai pandang mata

en: Adjust listening style to the situation
Overlook style differences, focus on message

blocks.en: Selective listening (LO 2.5) is not explained in the slide text. Extra (not in slides): it means hearing only what you want to hear. Check your textbook.
blocks.ms: Pendengaran terpilih (LO 2.5) tidak dijelaskan dalam teks slaid. Extra (bukan dalam slaid): bermaksud hanya mendengar apa yang anda mahu dengar. Semak buku teks.
Guna komunikasi bukan lisan dengan berkesan

blocks.en: Memory hook: F-G-V-P-T-T (Face, Gesture, Voice, Personal look, Touch, Time/space).
blocks.ms: Cara ingat: F-G-V-P-T-T (Face, Gesture, Voice, Personal look, Touch, Time/space).

en: Be conscious of how your voice sounds
End calls with courtesy and clarity
Use your outgoing voicemail message to help callers
Be considerate and clear when leaving voicemail
ms: Tamat panggilan dengan sopan dan jelas
Guna mesej peti suara untuk bantu pemanggil
Bertimbang rasa dan jelas bila tinggalkan peti suara

en: Meeting others: introduce yourself, introduce others, observe customs (especially international business)
Business meals: choose foods that are easy to eat, avoid alcohol, choose appropriate conversation topics
Representing your company; observing dining etiquette
ms: Berjumpa orang: perkenal diri, perkenal orang lain, patuhi adat (terutama perniagaan antarabangsa)

en: Avoid personal attacks; stay on topic; don’t present opinions as facts
Use virus protection and secure passwords
Ask if it is a good time to IM chat
Avoid profanity and emoticons; avoid multitasking
Don’t waste others’ time with sloppy messages; respect boundaries
Be careful of online commenting mechanisms
ms: Elak serangan peribadi; kekal pada topik; jangan sampaikan pendapat sebagai fakta
Guna perlindungan virus dan kata laluan selamat
Tanya sama ada sesuai untuk IM
Elak carutan dan emotikon; elak multitugas
Jangan bazirkan masa orang dengan mesej cuai; hormati sempadan
Berhati-hati dengan mekanisme komen dalam talian

en: Be aware of expectations and policies
ms: Amalkan tabiat penggunaan peribadi yang baik

blocks.en: Table 2.4 (Dressing for Success) has four columns of wardrobe advice: smooth and finished; elegant and refined; crisp and starched; up-to-the-minute trendy. Each column builds on the one before.
blocks.ms: Jadual 2.4 (Dressing for Success) ada empat lajur nasihat pakaian: kemas dan licin; elegan dan halus; kemas berkanji; terkini dan bergaya. Setiap lajur menambah lajur sebelumnya.

q.en: Define a team.
q.ms: Takrifkan pasukan.

a.en: A unit of two or more people who share a mission and responsibility for achieving a common goal.
a.ms: Unit dua orang atau lebih yang berkongsi misi dan tanggungjawab mencapai matlamat bersama.

q.en: Which team type is formal and long-lived?
q.ms: Jenis pasukan mana formal dan berjangka hayat panjang?

a.en: Committee.
a.ms: Jawatankuasa.

q.en: Four advantages of teams?
q.ms: Empat kelebihan pasukan?

a.en: Increased information and knowledge, increased diversity of views, increased acceptance of a solution, higher performance levels.
a.ms: Maklumat dan pengetahuan, kepelbagaian pandangan, penerimaan penyelesaian, prestasi lebih tinggi.

q.en: Four disadvantages of teams?
q.ms: Empat kekurangan pasukan?

a.en: Groupthink, hidden agendas, cost, overload.
a.ms: Groupthink, agenda tersembunyi, kos, beban berlebihan.

q.en: Five characteristics of effective teams?
q.ms: Lima ciri pasukan berkesan?

a.en: Clear purpose; open and honest communication; consensus-based decisions; creativity; effective conflict resolution.
a.ms: Tujuan jelas; komunikasi terbuka dan jujur; keputusan konsensus; kreativiti; penyelesaian konflik berkesan.

q.en: Four factors influencing group dynamics?
q.ms: Empat faktor mempengaruhi dinamik kumpulan?

a.en: Roles assumed, phase of team development, conflict resolution skills, effectiveness at overcoming resistance.
a.ms: Peranan diambil, fasa pembangunan, kemahiran selesai konflik, keberkesanan mengatasi tentangan.

q.en: Name the three categories of team roles.
q.ms: Namakan tiga kategori peranan pasukan.

a.en: Task-oriented (functional), team-maintenance (functional), self-oriented (dysfunctional).
a.ms: Berorientasikan tugas (fungsian), penyelenggaraan pasukan (fungsian), berorientasikan diri (tidak fungsian).

q.en: Give examples of dysfunctional self-oriented roles.
q.ms: Beri contoh peranan tidak fungsian berorientasikan diri.

a.en: Controlling, withdrawing, attention seeking, diverting.
a.ms: Controlling, withdrawing, attention seeking, diverting.

q.en: Give team-maintenance roles.
q.ms: Beri peranan penyelenggaraan pasukan.

a.en: Encouraging, harmonizing, compromising.
a.ms: Encouraging, harmonizing, compromising.

q.en: Four steps to overcome resistance?
q.ms: Empat langkah mengatasi tentangan?

a.en: Actively listen, express interest, ask questions, move towards resolution via collaboration.
a.ms: Dengar aktif, tunjuk minat, tanya soalan, bergerak ke penyelesaian melalui kolaborasi.

q.en: Which collaborative writing guideline says NOT to do something?
q.ms: Garis panduan penulisan kolaboratif mana melarang sesuatu?

a.en: Avoid composing as a group.
a.ms: Elak mengarang sebagai kumpulan.

q.en: Name four collaboration technologies.
q.ms: Namakan empat teknologi kolaborasi.

a.en: Track changes and commenting, collaboration systems, content management systems, shared online workspaces (also social networks, mobile).
a.ms: Track changes dan komen, sistem kolaborasi, sistem pengurusan kandungan, ruang kerja dikongsi.

q.en: Give four tips for constructive feedback.
q.ms: Beri empat tip maklum balas membina.

a.en: Discuss improvements not flaws; focus on controllable behaviour; be specific; keep it impersonal; verify understanding; time it carefully.
a.ms: Bincang penambahbaikan; fokus tingkah laku boleh dikawal; spesifik; tidak peribadi; sahkan kefahaman; masa sesuai.

q.en: Four steps in preparing for a meeting?
q.ms: Empat langkah menyediakan mesyuarat?

a.en: Define purpose, select participants, choose time and venue, set agenda.
a.ms: Tentukan tujuan, pilih peserta, pilih masa dan tempat, tetapkan agenda.

q.en: Six ways to conduct an efficient meeting?
q.ms: Enam cara mengendalikan mesyuarat cekap?

a.en: Keep discussion on track, follow rules, encourage participation, participate actively, use mobile devices respectfully, close effectively.
a.ms: Fokus, ikut peraturan, galak penyertaan, sertai aktif, guna peranti dengan hormat, tutup berkesan.

q.en: Four types of virtual meeting technology?
q.ms: Empat teknologi mesyuarat maya?

a.en: Instant messaging, teleconferencing, telepresence, webinars.
a.ms: Pesanan segera, telesidang, telepresence, webinar.

q.en: How do you keep virtual meetings successful?
q.ms: Bagaimana mengekalkan mesyuarat maya berjaya?

a.en: Extra planning, know technology limits, keep participants engaged and prepared, give chances to participate.
a.ms: Perancangan tambahan, tahu had teknologi, pastikan peserta terlibat dan bersedia, beri peluang menyertai.

q.en: Name the four listening types on slide 30.
q.ms: Namakan empat jenis mendengar pada slaid 30.

a.en: Content, critical, empathic, active.
a.ms: Kandungan, kritis, empati, aktif.

q.en: Five steps in the listening process?
q.ms: Lima langkah proses mendengar?

a.en: Receiving, decoding, remembering, evaluating, responding.
a.ms: Menerima, menyahkod, mengingat, menilai, bertindak balas.

q.en: What do effective listeners do with questions?
q.ms: Apa pendengar berkesan buat dengan soalan?

a.en: Save questions or disagreement until an appropriate time.
a.ms: Simpan soalan atau ketidaksetujuan hingga masa sesuai.

q.en: Six categories of nonverbal expression?
q.ms: Enam kategori ekspresi bukan lisan?

a.en: Facial expression, gesture and posture, vocal characteristics, personal appearance, touch, time and space.
a.ms: Ekspresi muka, gerak isyarat dan postur, ciri vokal, penampilan, sentuhan, masa dan ruang.

q.en: Three areas of business etiquette in the workplace?
q.ms: Tiga bidang etiket perniagaan di tempat kerja?

a.en: Personal appearance, personal grooming, phone skills.
a.ms: Penampilan, dandanan diri, kemahiran telefon.

q.en: Which food advice applies at business meals?
q.ms: Nasihat makanan apa untuk jamuan perniagaan?

a.en: Choose foods that are easy to eat and avoid alcohol.
a.ms: Pilih makanan mudah dimakan dan elak alkohol.

q.en: Three online etiquette rules about privacy and security?
q.ms: Tiga peraturan etiket dalam talian tentang privasi dan keselamatan?

a.en: Never assume privacy, use secure passwords, use virus protection.
a.ms: Jangan anggap ada privasi, guna kata laluan selamat, guna perlindungan virus.

q.en: What should you avoid with “Reply All”?
q.ms: Apa perlu dielak dengan “Reply All”?

a.en: Do not use it unnecessarily; it wastes others’ time.
a.ms: Jangan guna sewenang-wenangnya; membazirkan masa orang lain.

e.en: Committees are formal, long-lived and meet regularly.

q.ms: Pasukan mana bubar apabila matlamat dicapai?

e.en: Task forces and problem-solving teams disband after the goal.

e.ms: Pasukan berkesan guna konsensus dan selesai konflik dengan berkesan.

e.en: Listen, express interest, ask questions, collaborate.
